action.objective: Castle kingside to secure the king and complete development, keeping the position balanced.
action.rationale: e1g1 is the only commit-ready move, verified at depth 3 with exact score -12 (strongest exact evidence), full mate-in-one safety check, and no tactical refutation. Castling activates the h1 rook, improves king safety, and consolidates development. The alternative e2g4 was an upper-bound score (-22) at shallower depth with d6f4 winning the knight (e3f4 recapture loses the bishop pair but keeps material). No analysis budget remains (analysis_nodes_available=0), so committing the verified move is correct.
